findings.text: Upheld as advisory (question 2): the forget step (dropRepoRows plus the knowledge_repos delete) is written in both rebuildAll and refreshOne (line 809). One forgetRepo(db, id) helper would hold it. Only one statement is repeated. Carried from round four with no change.
Upheld as advisory (question 2): refreshOne repeats ensureFresh's freshness predicate (head and fingerprint, line 781). One shared predicate would serve both.
Upheld as advisory (question 2): searchEntries builds its placeholders inline although the file's placeholders helper already does this.
Upheld as advisory (question 2): TypeSafeJudge.relate and the heuristic relate repeat the same RelateInput-to-ConsolidateTexts mapping and the same id-to-index verdict mapping.
Upheld as advisory (questions 2 and 6): the kind list is written in four places (entry.ts, tools.ts, render.ts, opencode-plugin.ts) and nothing ties them together.
Upheld as advisory (question 2): KNOWLEDGE_LINE copies contribute.ts's intro and count wording as regex literals. Only a test ties the copies together. Architecture's F-2 names the same issue.
Upheld as advisory (question 9): getKnowledge calls freshen before its own REF check. The zod schema rejects a bad ref first on every tool path, so the inner check is either dead or too late.
Upheld as advisory (question 9): the ?? "workspace" fallback cannot be reached. If it ever were, it would mislabel a proposal and give no warning.
Upheld as advisory (questions 4 and 5): proposeKnowledge's KnowledgeError catch duplicates runTool's catch at line 491 on its only production path.
Upheld as advisory (questions 2 and 6): the bare catch throws away checkedAgentId's error and writes its message again by hand instead of printing error.message.
Upheld as advisory (question 5): pinnedLine only forwards to entryLine.

Upheld as advisory (question 6): three catches (lines 713, 743, 752) detect a missing table by matching the error message, while status and compact query sqlite_master. The change has two ways of answering one question.
Upheld as advisory (question 1): knowledgeRepositories is about 250 lines and does several separate jobs. It is still one check.
Upheld as advisory (question 9): a rate row that cannot be read silently opens a new window, and nothing is logged. Only this code writes that row.

Upheld as advisory (question 1, one clause): no test would fail if the knowledge_shown prune ran in its own transaction after the session delete, so AC-27's 'same transaction' clause rests only on a code comment. The rest of the criterion is covered.

Upheld as advisory (question 1, structural clause): no test tells one transaction per repository apart from one transaction with a catch per repository. The visible outcome, that the other repositories are still rebuilt, is proven.
Upheld as advisory (question 5): the 'by rowid' check runs EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN on the exported constants (also at line 338). It would not fail if the writer stopped using those constants.

Upheld as advisory (auth): a local client can rotate its handshake name to get about 11 rate windows. Part 1's quotas still cap the volume, a person must still accept every proposal, and ADR 0024 records that the id is not authenticated.

Upheld as advisory (public-api, hardening): knowledge_search.query has no maximum length, and knowledge_propose.body (line 443) is bounded only after redaction. A local agent can pass an unbounded string, but nothing is exposed.

Upheld as advisory (personal-data): knowledge_get puts the entry's author name into the agent's context, and ADR 0024's personal-data section names only on_behalf_of. Today every author is the local person, so nobody new sees the name.

Advisory, outside this item: the hard-coded plural reads '1 projects share knowledge' (review/ui/settings-sharing-problems@1512.png). The line belongs to sibling item 2026-11-09-002 and was ruled under that item.

Advisory, outside this item: the problems alert reads like a log line (review/ui/settings-sharing-problems@1512.png). The line is sibling item 2026-11-09-002's, and the reviewer files it as advisory copy.
Advisory, outside this item: the sharing pill is drawn in the LINKS column (review/ui/projects-row-pill-knowledge@1512.png). The line is sibling item 2026-11-09-002's.

Lowered to advisory. Question 10 makes a console error a defect, but two things hold here. First, the line is sibling item 2026-11-09-002's interface, ruled under its own item, not this item's change. Second, the entry is the browser's network log of the 500 that the error state provokes on purpose (review/ui/console-settings-sharing-error.json), and the page handles it with a plain toast. Ruled the same way in every earlier round.
Advisory, outside this item: the disabled radio list looks almost the same as the enabled one (review/ui/projects-dock-no-remote@1512.png). The line is sibling item 2026-11-09-002's.
Advisory, debt: the compact preview does not show the new knowledgeShown count. AC-25 asks only that the route carry the count, and ui/src/api.ts:137 does.

Upheld as advisory (question 5): the spec states the rollback to 0.6.0, and the two probes measure it for the hooks, the commands and compact. The probes name what was not run (0.6.0's drain with distillation, the viewer, a lockfile release build). The rollback and its limits are stated, not missing, so this is not a defect on the spec line. 0.6.0 does not know the module tables.

Upheld as advisory (question 1): a wall clock that steps backward during a session could make that session's own knowledge_shown rows look older than its start, so its pins would be shown again. The harm is bounded at one extra pinned block within 840 characters, and nothing is lost.

Advisory, debt: a hook that times out behind a writer prints nothing, and that was already true before this item. This item adds only its own bounded rebuildRepo transaction (under 50 ms, asserted by AC-27).
Advisory, debt: paths that delete a session without the module's prune leave orphan knowledge_shown rows. They are harmless to a reused id and pruned by the current compact.

Upheld as advisory: rootAreas is a second hand reader of the taxonomy file that copies taxonomyFor, while CLAUDE.md names doctor as the only one. A guard added to taxonomyFor later would not reach rootAreas. It runs no git.
Upheld as advisory: KNOWLEDGE_LINE is not built from contribute.ts's exported constants, so a wording change would silently stop the stripping. This repeats code-quality's F-6.
Upheld as advisory: ADR 0019's contract paragraph does not mention the ToolCall and globalInstructions additions or the new default. ADR 0024 records them.
Upheld as advisory: ConsolidateTexts types the text as plain string at the point where it leaves the machine. Both entry points still require Redacted, so nothing leaks today.
Upheld as advisory: the step that forgets a gone repository is written in both refreshOne and rebuildAll. This repeats code-quality's F-1.
Advisory, debt: taxonomyFor belongs to part 1 (item 2026-11-08-003) and does not call refuseLinkedRoots.
Upheld as advisory (questions 2 and 6): the FTS search runs under BEGIN IMMEDIATE, and its repo_id filter on an UNINDEXED column scales with the whole corpus. It is measured within the prompt budget.
Upheld as advisory (question 2): pinnedEntries reads every entry row of the visible repositories to find the pins. A partial index would read only the pins. It is measured within budget.
Upheld as advisory (question 6): nothing deletes the knowledge.rate:<agent id> meta rows, so their number has no fixed bound. Each row is small and holds no personal data.
Advisory, debt: sessions.id can be reused because it has no AUTOINCREMENT. The guards this item adds hold against it.
Advisory, outside this item: part 1's drop of the withdrawn module's tables. It sits behind backupVersion's backup and is listed by the reviewer for attribution only.
